requirements.desc: R1: preset エントリはファクトリ関数形式、Container への登録以外の副作用禁止
requirements.note: preset data modules were converted to `export default function register(container)` and loader now calls factories; legacy class-loading path was removed.

requirements.desc: R2: preset から sdd-forge 内部パス import を 0 箇所にする
requirements.note: migrated preset `data/*.js` files replace internal `../../../docs|lib` imports with `container.get(...)` / `container.getPreset(...)` access.

requirements.desc: R3: 親 preset 継承を Container 経由で提供
requirements.note: `Container.registerPreset/getPreset` was added and child presets resolve parent classes via `container.getPreset("...")`.

requirements.desc: R4: 37 プリセット全てを新形式に書き換え
requirements.note: diff shows broad `src/presets/**/data/*.js` factory migration plus register contract test iterating preset data files.

requirements.desc: R5: 旧 loader と sdd-forge/api exports を削除
requirements.note: `src/api.js` and `src/loader.js` were deleted; `package.json` exports removed `./api` and `./presets/*`; loader hook removed from `src/sdd-forge.js`.

requirements.desc: R6: scanner/path/lang/base classes を Container 経由で提供
requirements.note: `src/lib/container.js` now registers base classes and required scanner/path/lang/parser utilities as container keys.

requirements.desc: R7: API バージョン無し、peerDependencies のみで互換表現
requirements.note: no container API version field was introduced, but no concrete peerDependencies-based compatibility implementation is shown in product package manifests.

requirements.desc: R8: Container 拡張は追加のみで既存 preset を変更させない
requirements.note: dependency contract remains string-key based and additive; new services were added without replacing existing key scheme.

requirements.desc: R9: 移行前後の docs build 出力 diff ゼロを acceptance で検証
requirements.note: R9 artifacts were added, but provided evidence is not a strict all-preset zero-diff `docs build` acceptance result.

requirements.desc: R10: 全 preset の register() 契約テスト提供
requirements.note: `specs/191-preset-di-container/tests/register-contract.test.js` was added to validate factory contract across preset data modules.

requirements.desc: R11: 既存 preset-scan-integrity / preset-datasources テストが合格し続ける
requirements.note: tests were updated for the new loading contract, but this diff alone does not provide authoritative execution proof of continued pass status.
